findings.title: Unauthenticated mass-assignment edit endpoint
findings.message: PATCH /customers/:id merges the full request body into any customer record with no auth and no field allowlist — plan, mrr_usd, risk_score all attacker-settable.

findings.title: Auth-bypass (Level 2) → SQLi → admin takeover
findings.message: /rest/, /api/, /socket.io/ are not behind auth_basic. Verified live: unauthenticated SQLi login bypass on /rest/user/login returns a valid admin JWT.

findings.title: RBAC excessive permissions on public-app-sa
findings.message: public-app-sa's auto-mounted token can read Secrets in the protected namespace directly via the K8s API, bypassing NetworkPolicy entirely.

findings.title: SSRF → fake IMDS → excessive permissions chain
findings.message: SSRF in /preview pivots to internal-only metadata service, steals a fake IAM credential accepted by internal-api with no further checks — full admin takeover.

findings.title: IDOR on internal-api user lookup
findings.message: GET /internal/users/:id returns any user's fake record with no auth at all — reachable once the SSRF pivot lands you inside the internal network.

findings.title: NetworkPolicy empty namespaceSelector
findings.message: namespaceSelector: {} matches every namespace instead of just internal — lets public-namespace pods reach the protected canary over the network.

findings.title: github actions mutable action tag
findings.message: GitHub Actions step uses a mutable tag or branch reference. Tags and branch names can be silently repointed by the action owner, enabling supply-chain attacks —
cwe: CWE-1357: Reliance on Insufficiently Trustworthy Component
CWE-353: Missing Support for Integrity Check
